maya: Heads up — running into a gap w/ playbook automation: health-score triggers aren't firing for accounts missing last_activity + org_size. Any plan to backfill or change the rule? cc @sam @leo :eyes:

sam: Can you DM an example account? My quick check shows ~8% of active accounts have null last_activity. We have a nightly dedupe/backfill job for contact emails; we could extend to key CRM fields (last_activity, usage_metric, org_size). :thinking_face:

maya: Example: acme-inc (acct_id: 9832). Onboarding status shows 'in-progress' but score is null so no renewal-risk playbook. We need: 1) backfill last_activity from events table; 2) recompute healthscore + enqueue playbook triggers; 3) ensure idempotent triggers so customers don't get spammed.

leo: Agree. Proposed approach: add a scheduled SQL backfill that grabs last_activity from events, then publish affected account_ids to a cs-health-recompute Kafka topic. Throttle recompute consumers to ~10 accounts/sec. Quick SQL:
```sql
SELECT account_id, MAX(event_ts) AS last_activity
FROM events
WHERE event_type IN ('api_call','ui_activity')
GROUP BY account_id
```
This will handle the majority of missing values.

jen: Also need auditability — surface which playbooks ran historically. Can we add playbook_last_trigger timestamp and playbook_history reference on the account row?

sam: Yes. I'll open a ticket and sketch the migration + Airflow DAG. Airflow pseudo-step:
```py
with DAG('cs_backfill_health', schedule='@daily') as dag:
    backfill = PostgresOperator(sql='...backfill SQL...')
    publish = PythonOperator(python_callable=publish_to_kafka)
    recompute = KubernetesPodOperator(cmd='recompute-consumer --throttle=10')
    backfill >> publish >> recompute
```
I'll also add a small memo about idempotency: recompute job should check playbook_last_trigger and only fire if score crosses thresholds or if last_trigger older than 14 days.

onboard-bot: Created ticket CSOPS-4123: Backfill last_activity + healthscore recompute — assignee: @sam — due 2026-03-30.

maya: :thumbsup: Thanks. Can we also include a one-off run for the upcoming renewal cohort (list of ~120 accounts) after the backfill? Need to flag high-risk customers before next renewal review.

sam: Added a manual-run step in CSOPS-4123 and will attach the cohort CSV. Will include priority ordering and a way to mark 'urgent' so CS can triage. Ping me if any accounts should run first.
